method.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 cargo rustdoc --offline -p <package> [--features <features>] --lib -- -Z unstable-options --output-format json
method.inventory_rule: crate-local items with public visibility, plus members of public enums and public traits; associated public functions are annotated with their owning public type
method.reexports: retained as source declarations; the same underlying item can therefore appear in multiple crates

limitations: This is a syntactic public-surface snapshot, not proof that every item is numerically correct or supported for every provider/storage/device combination.
Experimental status is not encoded by Rust; feature-gated surfaces remain NEEDS-PROOF unless current source and executable tests establish their operation rows.
Raw rustdoc JSON is reproducible from the pinned authority and is omitted to avoid committing compiler-internal bulk data.
